messages:
jordan_m: Heads-up — Liam from Acme asked for SIEM / admin-audit evidence to finish the security review for the POC. They want: retention numbers, where logs flow (ingest path), sample admin events, and proof that admin actions are immutable. Can we compile a short packet?

maya_se: 👍 I can pull an example log export and an architecture blurb. Quick Q: do they need cloud-provider specifics (CloudWatch/Stackdriver) or just our internal pipeline (collector -> kafka -> es)?

liam_corpsec: hi — we need both. Our SOC wants the ingestion path so we can map it to our SIEM. Also need retention guarantees and how to prove admin action auditability (who changed what, when).

olivia_sg: TL;DR: Redwood stores control-plane audit events in an append-only audit store, encrypted at rest with customer-managed KMS for Private deployments. For hosted: logs are exported to a customer-specific tenant in our logging cluster, with 90d default retention (extendable). We sign rollover manifests for integrity checks.

olivia_sg: Details we can provide: (1) diagram of ingestion path, (2) sample audit events (redacted), (3) retention config and SLA wording, (4) instructions for forwarding to customer SIEM (syslog/s3/HTTPS).

maya_se: Example ingest path (short):
- service -> fluentd/collector -> kafka (internal topic per-customer) -> log-processor -> elastic/archive-s3 -> siem-forwarder
We can export as: splunk-hec, S3 bucket (parquet/json), or syslog.

jordan_m: Perfect. Liam — will a sample JSON export + a short writeup + a diagram work for your SOC? Also they asked for a signed proof for admin changes (immutability).

liam_corpsec: Yes. Signed manifests would be ideal. Also we need an example of an "admin_action" event with fields they expect: actor, actor_id, timestamp, action_type, resource, before/after (if applicable), request_id. Redact any PII.

dave_se: I'll drop a sample redacted event. Example: 
```
{
  "event_type": "admin_action",
  "actor": "jordan_m",
  "actor_id": "user-1234",
  "timestamp": "2026-02-18T15:21:03Z",
  "action": "update_model_config",
  "resource": "model/ggml-v2/1234",
  "request_id": "req-9a8b7c",
  "before": "{...}",
  "after": "{...}"
}
```
This matches what our audit pipeline emits. We can replace actor_id with a hashed id for export.

olivia_sg: On immutability: we generate signed manifest files (SHA256) per-day for each customer topic and keep them in a write-once storage layer for hosted customers. For Private deployments customers can configure their own WORM storage. We can include the manifest produce command + verification snippet.

maya_se: Verification snippet (example):
```
# verify manifest
sha256sum -c manifest-20260218.sha256
# shows OK for listed files
```

jordan_m: Can we also include retention policy excerpt and how to request extended retention or log export TTL? Liam's SOC asked about legal/ediscovery hold options.

olivia_sg: Hosted plan: default 90 days token logs/30 days request debug traces; optional archival to S3 up to 7 years (paid). Dedicated/Private: configurable via console + API. For eDiscovery we offer hold flag per-customer which suspends deletions; needs signed SoW for legal hold for hosted.

liam_corpsec: Good. Can you confirm encryption in transit and at rest details and KMS type (cloud KMS vs HSM)? We run a KMS key-signed policy.

olivia_sg: In transit: TLS1.2+ with mTLS between internal components. At rest: server-side AES-256. Hosted uses provider KMS (customer-key option available); Dedicated/Private supports customer-managed KMS and HSM-backed keys for signing manifests. We'll include the KMS config docs.

dave_se: I'll attach a redacted export (JSON) and a short runbook on how to forward to Splunk/Elastic/Sumo. Also add a sample Splunk HEC cURL for ingestion.

evidence_bot: Uploaded: /assets/poc_acme/redacted_admin_events_20260218.json (preview)

evidence_bot: Uploaded: /assets/poc_acme/ingest-arch-diagram.png

jordan_m: Awesome — next steps: Maya and Dave to assemble the packet (sample JSON, manifest + verify snippet, diagram, retention excerpt). Olivia to draft a one-page security summary referencing CAIQ sections (Audit Logging, Encryption, Key Mgmt). I'll send to Liam by EOD.

liam_corpsec: Thanks all. If you can include expected log volume (GB/day) breakout for the POC (~3 endpoints, ~200 requests/min), that'll help our SIEM sizing.

maya_se: Quick estimate: ~1.2GB/day (requests + tokens + audit events) — will add precise calc in the packet.

jordan_m: Great. I'll follow up when packet is uploaded. :thumbsup:
